en-US.author: Watfaq Technologies Pty Ltd
en-US.description: A custom protocol, rule based network proxy software.
en-US.name: ClashRS
en-US.releaseNotes:
🐛 Bug Fixes
- (tailscale) Resolve relative state-dir against cwd and forward ephemeral flag (#1570) by @ibigbug
- (socks) Prevent panic on SOCKS5 UDP packet with truncated domain address (#1571) by @ibigbug
- (deps) Bump rustix to 1.1.6 to fix mips musl build (#1579) by @ibigbug
- (apple) Build clash-lib for iOS/tvOS without patched dependencies (#1583) by @ibigbug
🚜 Refactor
- (tuic) Migrate the outbound to the Wind backend (#1580) by @Itsusinn
📚 Documentation
- (readme) Point the iOS section at the ChocLite App Store page (#1582) by @ibigbug
🧪 Testing
- (wg) Use iptables-nft in wireguard test server config (#1581) by @ibigbug
🛠️ Builds
- (deps) Bump the npm-security-dependencies group across 1 directory with 4 updates (#1568) by @dependabot[bot]
- (deps-dev) Bump vite from 8.3.1 to 8.3.4 in /clash-dashboard in the npm-security-dependencies group across 1 directory (#1569) by @dependabot[bot]
- (deps) Bump hono from 4.13.8 to 4.13.14 in /clash-dashboard in the npm-security-dependencies group across 1 directory (#1572) by @dependabot[bot]
- (deps) Bump the rust-dependencies group with 31 updates (#1574) by @dependabot[bot]
- (deps) Bump the npm-dependencies group across 1 directory with 13 updates (#1573) by @dependabot[bot]
- (deps) Bump pageant from 0.2.3 to 0.2.5 in the rust-security-dependencies group across 1 directory (#1577) by @dependabot[bot]
- (deps) Bump the npm-security-dependencies group across 1 directory with 2 updates (#1578) by @dependabot[bot]
⚙️ Miscellaneous Tasks
- Replace deprecated serde_yaml dependency (#1567) by @lmmqxyx404
- Bump version to v0.10.11 by @github-actions[bot]
Full Changelog: https://github.com/ibigbug/clash-rs/compare/v0.10.10...v0.10.11
